title: Penthouse July 1983 John Lennon Prince Charles Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, July 1983, original $3.00 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold.

Cover features: The Secret (Violent) Life of John Lennon; Prince Charles After Dark - a royal insider tells all; The Advantages of Being Poor.

Back cover: Lucky Strike cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
